days.title: 천년 하노이
days.morning: Visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the One Pillar Pagoda and the Temple of Literature.
days.afternoon: Walk around Hoan Kiem Lake and Ngoc Son Temple, sip egg coffee with a lake view.
days.evening: Watch water puppetry and join a food tour on Ta Hien street.

days.title: 구시가지와 서호
days.morning: Heritage phở, a cyclo ride through the 36 streets and Dong Xuan market.
days.afternoon: Hoa Lo Prison, Train Street and the Opera House.
days.evening: Sunset at West Lake, shrimp cakes and the weekend walking street.

days.title: 전통 공예 마을
days.morning: Bat Trang ceramic village – make your own pottery.
days.afternoon: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology with stilt houses of many ethnic groups.
days.evening: Chả cá Lã Vọng and live music at an Old Quarter café.

days.title: 흐엉 사원
days.morning: Boat along Yen stream among the mountains to Thien Tru pagoda.
days.afternoon: Cable car to Huong Tich cave – "the most beautiful cave in the South".
days.evening: Back in Hanoi, bún chả on Hang Manh street.

days.title: 드엉럼 – 바비
days.morning: Duong Lam ancient village with its gates and century-old laterite houses.
days.afternoon: Ba Vi National Park, Upper Temple and pine forest.
days.evening: Try hill chicken and Ba Vi yoghurt.
